description:
This build is for situations where you will not get harrassed in dark age and preferably early feudal and uses 5 mounted villagers to collect deer on the map and get the food for FC, saving the food under your TC for later.
After the initial mounted villagers, you make normal villagers to spend the food and to not deplete your initial gold too fast.
I chose to go up with Great Pasture and Mountain Hall to be able to spam Grassland Iron Pagodas and Monks upon age-up and compete for the relics.
With this build you can spam Iron Pagoda's almost continuously using only Grassland horses (so with 25 food discount and instant training). This is because the horses spawn faster in Castle Age and you have already 3 grasslands (incl. Great Pasture).
If you like this build or you have any suggestions, leave a comment :)
name: Jin FC taking outside hunt
author: Flip

notes: Three starting @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ go on @resource/resource_gold.webp@, build @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ with 1.

Drop off food (should be able to queue 3 vills now), take all 5 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ and @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/mill.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@. Research @technology_jin/mohe-ancestry.webp@.
Next 2 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ go on straggler tree @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to collect 50 for a @building_economy/house.webp@.

@resource/rally.webp@ next @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@. When you have 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@ and go on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ with these vills.
You will have enough to age up with @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@. Take 2 from @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and rally 1 more from TC.

Then @resource/rally.webp@ to the already cut straggler tree to gather 100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for @building_jin/grassland.webp@. These villagers will move to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ after finishing the tree, so you can shift-queue the rally point from the tree to the gold.
When the tree finishes,  @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (next straggler) for the next 3 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@, we will need a @building_economy/house.webp@.
Aim for this distribution just before reaching @age/age_2.webp@.
1 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ villager builds @building_economy/house.webp@ just before 20 pop. TC@resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@.

Take 8 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ off the @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_jin/mountain-hall.webp@ next to @building_economy/town-center.webp@ so it covers the most resources. When the hunt runs out, take your 5 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ back to mine @resource/resource_gold.webp@.  @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ with the @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@when you can.
Make @unit_religious/monk-3.webp@ and take @resource/relics.webp@, research Veterancy for @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ and use only grassland horses to spawn them. Use them to harrass enemy villagers.
Make @unit_jin/emissary.webp@ from @building_economy/town-center.webp@ and take the nearest neutral market.
You can now make mounted vills again! @resource/rally.webp@ @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Build @building_jin/grassland.webp@ when you can, build @building_jin/war-stable.webp@ if the grassland is not under the influence of @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@.
Use @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to make farms when you have excess wood.
Build additional @building_religious/monastery.webp@ to cover next gather locations.
If you have too much gold, buy @technology_jin/collective-hunting.webp@.
Make some counter units if the @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ are not enough to keep the enemy contained.
Queue 2 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to start and Rally to @resource/sheep.webp@.
Around this time you should be close to Age Up. DON'T FORGET HOUSES!!
Keep making @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@and Rally to Straggler Trees
Take 2 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@off @resource/sheep.webp@and put them on Straggler Trees
Build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@with 3 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@and stick to these until you have enough for @building_economy/mill.webp@/@building_economy/house.webp@
Can have very little or 0 Vills on @resource/resource_wood.webp@at this point until Age Up
Can make @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@or @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ if you need early army
Research Upgrade to @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@and @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@/// DON'T FORGET HOUSES
Look to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_jin/machine-workshop.webp@and @building_military/barracks.webp@depending on what you want
Can go heavier on @resource/resource_food.webp@/@resource/resource_gold.webp@for the later game because you can look for a @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@/@unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@comp

Use 2 @resource/resource_food.webp@ --> @resource/resource_wood.webp@ Use 1 @resource/resource_gold.webp@--> @resource/resource_stone.webp@  Make a regular VILL post-age up since you don't have the gold as you just spent it @building_economy/house.webp@when possible.
2 @resource/resource_food.webp@ --> @resource/resource_stone.webp@ Important to have just 2 on food, regular @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@on @resource/resource_food.webp@
Stop at 300 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, then move those 3 around where you want 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@, build when enough wood
If no aggression push for fast castle (MUST SCOUT) @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ 1 to @resource/resource_gold.webp@1 to @resource/resource_food.webp@
Have enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@to make Stables, and archery Ranges, build @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@and @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@
After getting all of your wood to make Stable & Archery Range Re-Macro Rally to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and just remacro gold and food while keeping 5-7 on wood
When enough @resource/resource_food.webp@ to age up. Move @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@spot
Next 3 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@, move to @resource/deer.webp@ when @unit_jin/reindeer-trader.webp@ run out and get @technology_jin/mohe-ancestry.webp@
Once got enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for 2 @building_economy/market.webp@, move 2 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@

author: Jockxtar

notes: Move both @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ after they drop enough @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (@abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/mining-camp.webp@)
@landmark_jin/flower-pagoda.webp@ skill on @resource/resource_food.webp@ (and, if possible, on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ too)
Drop @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and build @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@ with 6 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ (keep 1 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@)
Start making @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ instead of @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ now that you have @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Try to not get stuck in @age/age_2.webp@. Make @building_economy/farm.webp@ with @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ if you run out of @resource/resource_food.webp@
